summary: Install-time execution of obfuscated encrypted payload via binding.gyp and Bun runtime
details: The package ships a binding.gyp whose target has type "none" and no C/C++ source files; its only purpose is a GYP `<!(...)` command-expansion that runs `node index.js` during the automatic `node-gyp rebuild` triggered by `npm install`. index.js is multi-layer obfuscated: a char-code array is Caesar-decoded (shift 21) and passed to eval; the decoded body reads the bundled lib_native.dat (~312 KB, high-entropy, sha256 e1ab1e330d3db532d511d4af4386ab2d2c6245ca807410f51c1211ae48814d73), brotli-decompresses and AES-128-GCM-decrypts it with hardcoded key/IV/AAD, writes the plaintext to a `mkdtempSync('.b-')/index.js` temp path, and spawns the Bun runtime (`Bun.spawn`, or `getBunPath()` via child_process.spawn) to execute the decrypted payload. Executing under Bun bypasses Node-only analysis. The contents of the executed payload are not inspectable from the shipped artifact.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
